## What's new

**Signalith Agent**
- **Windows on ARM.** The install line now sets up the agent on Windows 11 on ARM (Snapdragon and other ARM PCs). The agent runs as an ARM program, with the x86 Fluent Bit and osquery Windows runs on ARM, and Sysmon's ARM build. Servers hand out the new `signalith-agent-windows-arm64.exe`, and the manual Fluent Bit steps now say to use the win64 installer on ARM PCs, since Fluent Bit's ARM build 5.1.3 crashes as it starts sending.
